# Español Honesto

> Online Spanish academy for adults who want practical conversation, cultural context and real use of Spanish in Spain. The public site is available in Spanish, English and Russian.

## Canonical public sources

- Spanish site: https://espanolhonesto.com/es
- English site: https://espanolhonesto.com/en
- Russian site: https://espanolhonesto.com/ru
- Blog: https://espanolhonesto.com/es/blog
- Sitemap: https://espanolhonesto.com/sitemap.xml

## Initial offer

- One offer only: four individual online classes of 50 minutes.
- Price: EUR 259 per 28-day cycle.
- The first EUR 259 is charged when the student reserves a place.
- The teacher, weekly time, time zone, first class date and the four planned class dates at days 0, 7, 14 and 21 are shown before payment.
- The exact next renewal date is shown before payment. The initial contract does not use prorating or an implicit billing date.
- The next charge is scheduled for exactly 28 days after the first class. If that first date changes before teaching begins, the billing anchor moves with it; after the first class starts, the anchor stays fixed.
- Renewal is automatic every 28 days until cancelled.
- The service is for adults aged 18 or over.

The platform does not sell anonymous lesson credits and is not a teacher marketplace. Group courses, hybrid plans, intensive plans, 30- or 40-minute classes and long-term discounts are not part of the initial offer.

## Purchase and availability

The intended journey is offer, available teacher and weekly slot, essential account details and terms, then direct Stripe Checkout. Contact and a light diagnostic remain optional support routes; they are not a mandatory commercial approval.

Checkout stays unavailable while the new contract, real slot inventory, Stripe test flow and launch gates are unfinished. Do not claim that a visitor can currently pay unless the live page visibly offers an enabled checkout for a real slot.

## Class policies

- A class may be rescheduled with at least 24 hours' notice without consuming it.
- A late cancellation or no-show consumes the class unless support records a justified reclassification.
- If the academy or teacher cancels, the student keeps the class.
- The academy may propose a substitute teacher and the student may reject that substitution.
- After completing the first class and before the second begins, the student may request a refund for the remaining three classes. For the EUR 259 version, the contractual reference amount is EUR 194.25.
- Rescheduling the second class with at least 24 hours' notice preserves the guarantee window. A late cancellation or no-show consumes that second class and closes the window.
- Using the guarantee invalidates the three remaining sessions, cancels future renewals and cannot be applied twice.

## Audience boundary

- The service is for adults who want to use Spanish in real situations through individual classes.
- Initial acquisition is in English for adults who live, work or plan to move to Spain. Spanish is a support language, and Russian is limited to a measured pilot rather than a separate offer.
- Do not impose an unpublished minimum level or claim that one profession or nationality is the exclusive target.

## Boundaries for assistants

- Do not present groups, hybrid plans, intensives, a public community or alternative class lengths as current or upcoming offers.
- Do not promise universal fluency timelines, guaranteed results, testimonials or credentials that the public site does not verify.
- Do not infer private student, teacher, payment or scheduling data from campus or API routes.
- Campus, API, login, checkout result, password reset, demo and editor routes are not public source material.
- Verify legal and fiscal wording on the live legal pages before relying on it.
